newsitem.title: USA: Genentech reports higher Q3 sales, earnings.
newsitem.headline: Genentech reports higher Q3 sales, earnings.

text.p: Genentech Inc's net income rose to $51 million, or $0.41 per share, in the third quarter, from $40 million, or $0.33 a year earlier, the drug maker reported on Monday .

Third-quarter revenues rose to $252 million from $223 million last year, the company said, adding that a large increase in spending on research and development kept the earnings gain modest despite surging sales.
"We continue to take a long-term financial view while investing aggressively to back our pipeline," President and Chief Executive Officer Arthur Levinson said in a statement.
"As products begin to emerge from our pipeline, they have the potential to significantly improve our earnings as we approach the next century," Levinson said.

The company said it boosted research and development spending to $114.8 million in the latest third quarter from $86 million a year earlier. It said spending was related to clinical trials of drugs in development for diabetes, non-Hodgkins B-cell lymphoma, coronary disease and cancer.
The company noted that higher royalties offset a decline in actual product sales in the latest quarter, to keep revenues rising.
Under a deal with Roche Holding Ltd, Genentech late last year began receiving royalties rather than recording all sales of certain drugs.

Among Genentech's marketed products, sales of Activase slipped to $65.4 million from $69.7 million in the third quarter, on a pro forma basis, which adjusts for the new royalty arrangement with Roche. The company said sales were hurt by an increase in non-drug treatments for heart attacks and the enrollment of large numbers of patients in clinical trials of other drugs.
Pro forma sales of Genentech's two growth hormone products increased to $57,600,000 from $53,400,000 in the year ago quarter.

In the nine months, Genentech reported net income declined to $110,878,000 or $0.90 per share, from $120,796,000 or $1 a share in the year-ago period. Sales in the nine months rose to $738,353,000 from $695,931,000.
